jobs.name: Berita AI Harian (Pagi)
jobs.prompt:
Tuan Hafizi mahu ringkasan berita AI TERKINI dihantar ke Telegram setiap pagi (waktu Malaysia). Jalankan tugasan ini sepenuhnya autonomi — jangan tanya soalan, jangan tunggu input. Output akhir anda ADALAH mesej yang dihantar (jangan guna send_message).

LANGKAH WAJIB:

1. skill_view(name='tech-news-digest') dan ikut workflow + pitfall di dalamnya.

2. Ground tarikh dulu (JANGAN agak dari ingatan):
   TZ=Asia/Kuala_Lumpur date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z'
   Window liputan = 24-48 jam terakhir sahaja.

3. Jalankan SEKURANG-KURANGNYA 4 web_search secara selari dalam satu round:
   - "AI news today <bulan> <hari> <tahun>"
   - "artificial intelligence announcement this week <bulan> <tahun>"
   - "open source AI model release <bulan> <tahun>"
   - "trending AI GitHub repositories <bulan> <tahun>"

4. LARANGAN KERAS — JANGAN guna web_extract walaupun sekali. Backend ddgs pada host ini memang rosak untuk extraction (gagal 100%). Untuk butiran penuh guna:
   (a) deep-search: 4-6 web_search bertarget pada tajuk berita (snippet + tarikh), dan
   (b) curl + script tempatan:
       curl -sL -A "Mozilla/5.0" -o /tmp/tc-home.html "https://techcrunch.com/"
       python3 /home/hafizi145/.hermes/skills/research/tech-news-digest/scripts/html-extract.py /tmp/tc-home.html
   Guna hanya URL yang datang dari hasil carian atau homepage — JANGAN reka slug/path URL, JANGAN reka nama repo atau bilangan star.

5. Fokus AI dahulu: model baru & benchmark, agent/agentic framework, open-weight release, AI infra/GPU/data center, polisi & regulasi AI, AI dalam bisnes/funding. Teknologi umum lain hanya kalau berkait AI.

6. Format laporan — BM casual + dialek Kelantan sedikit (sohor, goni, mung, kito, pacak megah) tapi jangan dipaksa. Scannable, bullet, ringkas (max ~450 patah perkataan):

# 🤖 Berita AI — <tarikh MYT>
## 🔥 Paling Panas
(3-5 item, mesti ada tarikh terbit dalam window 24-48 jam)
## 🤖 Open-Source & Model Baru
(3-4 item)
## ⭐ GitHub Naik Bukit

| Projek | Apa Dia | ⭐ |
|---|---|---|

## 📌 Apa Kito Patut Tahu
(2-4 bullet — kesan praktikal untuk HAFJET: OpenRouter/gateway, GPU lokal RTX, model Qwen/DeepSeek, agent Hermes)
## 📎 Sumber
(senarai bernombor + URL)

7. Kalau benar-benar TIADA berita AI baharu (semua item sudah dilaporkan dalam run sebelum ini), balas TEPAT: [SILENT]

8. Jangan guna execute_code (disekat dalam cron). Jangan guna python3 -c atau python3 << heredoc. Buat fail .py guna write_file kalau perlu.

jobs.name: HAFJET Monthly Gaji-Profit Tracker
jobs.prompt:
Run the HAFJET monthly Gaji vs Profit tracker update.

Steps:
1. Get Loyverse token: read /tmp/.loyverse_token (if missing, run: grep LOYVERSE_ACCESS_TOKEN ~/.hermes/.env | head -1 | cut -d= -f2- > /tmp/.loyverse_token)
2. Run the tracker script for the PREVIOUS month (not current). Compute it: if today is day 1, the target month is last month. Example: on Aug 1, run for July. Use Python in the script to derive last month automatically if possible, OR pass explicit args: python3 /tmp/gaji_profit_calc.py YYYY MM where YYYY MM = last month.
3. The script auto-fetches Loyverse sales for that month, subtracts fixed costs (Sewa RM400 + BSN RM400 + TNB RM500 = RM1300), computes net profit, baki hidup, and hire-readiness status, then updates ~/.hermes/reports/gaji_profit_tracker.csv automatically.
4. After the script runs, read the final lines of output and report a concise Telegram summary to Tuan Hafizi:
   - Bulan laporan
   - Jualan total
   - Net Profit
   - Kos Tetap (RM1,300)
   - Baki Hidup (after costs, before salary)
   - Status hire-readiness (READY / PART-TIME / BELUM + gap amount)
5. Keep the message short and scannable (bullet points). Use Malay. Note: API only returns 31 days history, so the run on day 1 captures the full previous month correctly.

Important: The script handles fetching, CSV update, and calculation. Just run it for the correct previous month and deliver the summary. If the token file is missing AND grep fails, report the blocker honestly — do not invent numbers.
